answer: Noise token injection at the wharf: each block hash seeds a pseudo-random micropayment of negligible value to every wallet, so identity count inflates gas-free but earns dust. Pigment marks provenance — wallets receiving identical noise patterns cluster as one operator. Timber locks the sybil out: faking distinct hash-seeded streams demands unique on-chain history, costing ~0.0003 ETH per identity. Break-even: below 40 identities farming pays; above it, noise overhead exceeds yield.
